items.title: WSM Q2 Deep Dive: Broad-Based Growth, Market Share Gains, and Raised Guidance
items.summary: Kitchenware and home goods retailer Williams-Sonoma (NYSE:WSM) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 6.7% year on year to $1.96 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.10 per share was 1.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
